codex_contract.preserved_semantics: Render a PR diff review as a Cursor Canvas that groups changes by reviewer importance, separates boilerplate from core logic, and highlights tricky or unexpected code. Use when reviewing a pull request, summarizing a diff for review, or when the user asks for a PR review canvas, diff walkthrough, or change-set overview.

native_mapping.fallback: Absent Canvas returns bounded local Markdown/HTML artifact paths and a parity gap; live PR metadata is not fetched.

permission_gates: Use a local Markdown/HTML fallback when Canvas is unavailable; a GitHub URL requires a separately authorized live capability.
Absent Canvas returns local artifact paths and a parity gap.
Require an explicit invocation and an explicit project root; reject symlinked or escaping paths and bounded-input violations.
Respect the current task scope, selected model/effort, repository ownership, and explicit approval requirements.

behavioral_proof.positive: A bounded local unified diff produced linked index.md and index.html files grouped by core logic, wiring/integration, and boilerplate/mechanical reviewer value, with stats, changed-line evidence callouts, and mechanical summaries; no PR or product state changed.
behavioral_proof.missing_tool_or_input: A GitHub URL returns an explicit missing-capability result because gh/live PR metadata is not invoked; a local fixture returns FALLBACK with canvas_parity UNAVAILABLE.
behavioral_proof.error: Malformed or empty diff input, unsafe paths, and oversized fixtures are reported explicitly before artifact writes; the adapter does not widen to network or publication.

upstream_readme.note: Verified in the pinned upstream clone; the README is referenced for provenance and is not vendored in this skills-only snapshot.

security_review.decision: Keep the source finding and provenance; do not dismiss it because the adapter adds a warning.
